female.sp: Gundam Lfrith Pre-Production Model, XGF-01 mass-production test unit. Use both attached official front and rear views as mechanical design authority. Preserve muted blue-gray armor, charcoal structural joints, small white waist and foot accents, yellow-gold layered chest vents and bright green optical sensors. Preserve the distinctive hooked white-edged shoulder pylons and the segmented narrow limb armor. Most importantly, preserve the complete backpack: a central dark blue-gray block with two circular thruster ports and TWO enormous long rounded-rectangular GUND-BIT launchers, one hanging vertically behind each side of her body on articulated horizontal mounting arms. Both launchers must remain separate, parallel and fully visible from top to bottom, reaching from above shoulder level to below hip level; they are launchers, never wings, shields, coffins or fabric. She carries no handheld rifle or sword in this portrait. Translate the compact green forehead sensor into a practical hair ornament while leaving a fully human face unobstructed; no Gundam face mask and no V-fin. Keep substantial shoulders, forearm and lower-leg armor while the open fitted design exposes collarbone, waist flanks and upper-thigh gaps between plates. Front-facing full-body portrait with face, torso, both feet, both full launchers and their mounting arms inside the image with generous margins. Pose otherwise freely chosen. No letters, model numbers, insignia, logos or background text. Face distinction: a very tall African woman in her twenties with deep skin, a long narrow elongated face, medium downturned green eyes, broad low nose bridge, wide mouth, angular jaw, and thick ash-blonde medium blunt-cut hair with center-parted curtain bangs. Her body is tall and lean with broad shoulders, a long torso, straight hips and very long slender legs. Do not resemble the pilot or any previous character. The first attached anthropomorphized image is the identity anchor for this SAME adult woman, preserving her exact elongated African face, green eyes, deep skin, ash-blonde blunt bob, age and very tall lean proportions. The official front and rear views anchor the mechanical equipment. Completely reinterpret the entire image in the selected polished anime illustration style, including face, skin, armor, both launchers, mounting arms and background with clearly drawn contours, anime-informed facial rendering and controlled graphic shading. Do not carry over the first image's semi-realistic painted skin or material treatment, and do not trace its composition. Keep the selected front-facing view while allowing a naturally different stance.
